items.hyp: Tshwetso, botlhe, botlhokwa, le tsamaiso e tshwanetse go dira gore re tswelela ka ditiragalo tsa rona le go dira gore re dira ka go lebega le le diragetseng ka ga Mokgatlho wa Kebabane wa mmasepala, re tshwanetse go dira go dira ka go lebega le le diragetseng ka ga ditirelo tse di dirang go diragetsang batho.
items.ref: Tlala, lehuma, botlhokatiro le go tlhoka tekatekano ke dingwe tse re tshwanetseng go lwana le tsona ka dikakanyo tsotlhe tsa rona mme jaaka re tlogela leina la Mmasepala wa selegae la Mbizana, re tshwanetse gape go netefatsa gore re dira ka natla go tlogela dilo tsotlhe tse di neng di le morwalo mo go bathong ba rona.

items.hyp: Mokaedi wa ditshwaelo tsa boitshwaro le tsa botlhe (COGTA), Mokaedi Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma a a tlhagelelang ka ga tlhopho ya go nna le seabe sa Mbizana go Winnie Madikizela Mandela Local Municipality.
items.ref: Tona ya Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA), Ngk Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma o ne a tsenetse moletlo o wa semmuso wa go fetola leina la Mbizana go nna Mmasepala wa selegae wa Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.

items.hyp: Mmeyara wa mokgatlho wa ditshwanelo tsa ga Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa Mafumbatha, a re go na le ditshwanelo tse di tswelapele go thusa batho ba lefatshe ba lekanyeditsweng go dira ditshwaelo tsa ntlha.
items.ref: Mmeyara wa Masepala o montšha o o tswang go kaiwa ka leina le le ntšha la Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa  Mafumbatha o rile, go na le mananeo a rulagantsweng go netefatsa gore batho ba lefelo le ba ungwa sengwe  go tswa mo segakeng sa tokologo.

items.hyp: Mafumbatha a re go tlhagelela ga ditlhopho tsa mmasepala go tlhagelela go dira ditirelo tse di farologaneng.
